newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's UDI bonds real return 6.42 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's UDI bonds real return 6.42 pct.

text.p: Mexico's UDI bonds were assigned at a price of 102.75852 UDIs and a real return of 6.42 percent at the primary auction on Monday.
Two weeks ago the UDI bonds had a real return of 6.48 percent and a price of 102.61660 UDIs.
Demand this week was 1.40 billion UDIs compared to 500 million UDIs on offer from Banco de Mexico with a bid-to-cover ratio of 2.80.
Two weeks ago demand was 2.385 billion UDIs with a bid-to-cover ratio of 4.77.
